title: The dashboard words a tracker-closed tick "up next" while counting it done
description:
statusWordOf takes the first not-done stage of a tick's pipeline, and for a tick whose only closure evidence is the tracker, claimState answers pending while workState, gateState and endState all read the tracker's close as done — so the word is "up next" and the tick lands in the UP NEXT group while the same screen's health line counts it done. The suite's honest watch frame shows both halves of the contradiction at once: "UP NEXT (4) t01 · t02 · t03 · t04" under "2 of 4 done". epic.go's stateOf already carries the case ("the answer came from the tracker or from nothing"), so it is reached whenever the readable records do not cover the tracker's closure — a tick closed by hand, or watched from a checkout whose run records are still on the run branch.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/statusword.go:71 with internal/statusmodel/pipeline.go:327-331; over tui's fixture world, `ticfac watch --json epic-hld` answers tick t01 state "closed", status "up next", groups.up_next [t01,t02,t03,t04], progress.ticks.closed 2
